task: Close a support-bundle redaction leak (#17: shell-quoted and split-quote headers, non-header keys, auth schemes), add a read-only adapter staging inventory card (#33) and a GPU metric availability table (#11); verify at hermetic unit/static scope only.

events.summary: Redaction: redact.rs shell-quote handling, shared AUTH_SCHEMES, REDACTION_RULES_VERSION 2->3 kept in sync with scripts/support/verify_support_bundle.py by a test, plus a bundle-level e2e test that plants secret sentinels and walks every produced file. UI: one read-only card on list_adapter_staging (no mutation). Docs: docs/04-architecture.md section 7. Out of scope and left unfixed: GPU load/memory failing to 0.0 (metrics.rs), stale 'unstarted' lines in docs/04.

Before the work, a log line 'curl -H \'Authorization: Basic ...\'' was not redacted and the e2e test failed with 'leaked in app.log'. After the first fix, an automated security review of the committed change reproduced a regression: -H 'X-Auth-Token: Bearer SECRET' became '[REDACTED] SECRET' (old code masked SECRET). Two earlier independent reviews, which attacked header keys, missed it. A key x scheme x form sweep then showed 48 of 672 cases still leaking (Digest/Negotiate not in AUTH_SCHEMES; a non-Authorization key masked only the scheme word, which also leaked before this work).

Every sensitive key opened inside a shell quote now masks up to the closing quote (JSON-safe end when unclosed), with a one-line carry only after a bare scheme; split-quote forms are covered for all sensitive keys; the unquoted path masks scheme plus the following credential for any sensitive key; AUTH_SCHEMES gained digest, negotiate and ntlm. Accepted limits are documented in redact.rs with reason and cost: blank, whitespace-only or oversized line between an open quote and its value, an unquoted token after a split quote, curl -u user:SECRET, and over-masking of prose after a sensitive key inside quotes.

make verify exit 0 after the last code change: 447 Rust tests passed, 2 ignored (opt-in on-device MLX), support-bundle Python tests 26 OK with 1 skipped (no real bundle supplied). New redact unit tests failed on the previous code before each fix. A scratch harness outside the repo ran 864 key x scheme x form cases against the final redactor with 0 leaks (672 cases, 48 leaks before the last fix). Final reviewer ran about 45 attack inputs, a 300k-iteration multibyte fuzz with no panic, and timing on 1 MB inputs; all new unit tests fail on the pre-fix code.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings, tsc --noEmit, check_ipc_types.py, vite build and the DESIGN.md lint all exit 0 as part of make verify.

Not observed: the Tauri app UI (the staging card was only type-checked and built; the repo has no frontend test runner), a real support bundle from the running app, a real cluster, and any real MLX run. The 864-case sweep is synthetic and does not prove no other secret shape leaks; the accepted limits in e3 are known leaks.

The redaction leak classes found by reviews and the sweep are closed at hermetic unit/e2e scope; the staging card and the metric table are implemented and statically checked. Not a claim that the redactor is complete or that the UI was observed.
A is limited to the executed hermetic unit, e2e and static checks; runtime and UI verification remain unobserved and redaction keeps documented accepted limits.
